codeSideFixes: Production email no longer treats console logging as delivery.
SMTP mode no longer silently falls back to console when relay configuration is absent.
Production Storage no longer silently falls back to local filesystem storage.
Production scheduler enqueue no longer silently drops jobs when Supabase is unavailable.
Privileged SCIM and legacy candidate SECURITY DEFINER RPCs are service-role-only.
Readiness endpoint now returns dependency readiness semantics instead of a configuration-only 200 response.
Environment example includes deployment, email, SCIM, project reference, and direct database verification variables.
Case-insensitive canonical production environment detection covers production/Production/PRODUCTION.
AI usage logs are now included in the migration chain.
SCIM tenant lookup avoids filter-expression interpolation.
Scheduler claim failures propagate instead of returning a false zero-job success.
externalBlockers: Supabase URL and keys are unavailable.
Storage, email, n8n, SCIM, telemetry, scheduler, and managed backup environments are unavailable.
